mxCell.value: Data flow from vendor files to the app
Simulation (engine built in M3; signals M4 and risk M5 planned)
raw_optionsdx_eod 33 bracketed columns, one wide row per date, expiry, strike; read in place from $VOL_DATA_DIR
raw_dolthub_option_chain 13 columns; queried through a private mirror in $VOL_DATA_DIR, never the shared clone; SPY rows exported once
Cboe VIX and VIX3M VIX3M is available: 4,304 rows
Fetch and parse reference series tools/build_data.py --fetch downloads into the repo's data/raw/; yfinance with auto_adjust=False
Date map from SPY bars calendar_actions: keep each session, drop every other vendor date; never from chain dates (OptionsDX: 12 closure dates, all dropped)
Load chains + pin schema OptionsDX parquet from $VOL_DATA_DIR and the exported DoltHub rows from data/raw/; a changed column stops the build
Reshape long, OSI symbol, quality_flags 13-bit bitmask in ADR-0009; rows are flagged, only calendar drops are deleted
quality_flag_counts, quality_calendar, quality_underlying, quality_rows_per_date, quality_non_session_dates The report; written even when the gate fails, so a failure can be read
Quality gate passed? Limits set after looking at the data; a failure raises QualityGateError and deletes any old option_quotes
option_quotes, calendar_actions 19,022,008 quotes, partitioned by source and year, in the repo's data/store/
DoltHub sampling mask for surface-gap runs chain_mask: the expiry and strike pairs DoltHub lists per date (dolthub), and with Tue/Thu carried forward (dolthub_daily)
Cross-vendor check, 2020-2023 30-day ATM IV and parity-implied SPY price on the 572 dates both vendors list; reports the share of dates inside each threshold, with no verdict
build_summary.json Counts, quantiles, shares inside the cross-vendor thresholds and the gate result; no clock time
tools/export_app_data.py: data_quality.json Aggregates only: flag counts per year, rows per source, calendar fixes, cross-vendor quantiles, gate limits
tools/build_pricing.py: one partition per process Each (source, year) of option_quotes priced on its own, in parallel; skipped when its quotes, reference tables and code are unchanged

Parity forward per expiry, de-Americanised Each near-K* quote solved for its American IV on the CRR lattice and its premium A - E there removed, one pass, then median F_K over 5 strikes near K* (ADR-0008)
IV solve on de-Americanised OTM mids Every OTM quote's premium at its American IV removed, no |k| band; Black-76 Newton then bisection; IV_FAIL, PARITY_OUTLIER, FORWARD_FALLBACK
Smile nodes in total variance Piecewise linear; wing, cross-expiry and tenor rules applied when a surface IV is read (ADR-0004)
expiry_forwards, quote_iv, smile_fits Partitioned by source and year in the repo's data/store/
pricing_summary.json Headline numbers by source, year and tenor, read back from the stored tables; no clock time
tools/export_app_data.py: surface_frames.json IVs of a few labelled dates on a fixed grid, read off the smiles
tools/run_backtest.py Builds the RunConfig and the strategy; passes the commit and build.require_current to the engine; --for-app records the run for the app
YearCache: the pricing tables a year at a time option_quotes, quote_iv, expiry_forwards, smile_fits of one source, two years in memory; reference tables whole. Only a view slices it
StoreView as_of t, one per session Built in M1; M3 adds quotes, quote_ivs, forwards and smiles. LookAheadError after t; SplitError past the split end; the engine's own reads use it too
Signals from the view: RV, HAR/GARCH, IV30 minus RV forecast (planned, M4) Causal; expanding window from 2000, refit monthly on data up to t (ADR-0001)

RollingShortStraddle (reference strategy) A diagnostic that exercises the engine, not a result: sells ATM straddles on the monthly expiry nearest 30 days, closes when DTE at the next session is 7 or less

volbt.engine.loop.run_backtest: eleven steps per session Load, start of day, fills, settlement, marks, hedge, daily_pnl, risk (ruin only), decide, early exercise, write. Steps in engine_daily_loop_sequence.mmd

Ledger: runs, positions, orders, order_legs, fills, lots, position_marks, hedges, expiry_events, risk_events, daily_pnl, cash_flows One parquet file per table in work_dir()/runs/run_id=ID/ (the id is the folder name), written once, plus run_meta.json. signals (M4) and greeks_snapshots (M5) are planned
volbt.engine.report check_ledger: file SHA-256s against run_meta.json and the run id's derivation, before and after the read; blotter_body, positions_timeline_body; no P&L (D19)
tools/export_app_data.py: blotter.json and positions_timeline.json Adds the envelope; reads the run recorded in app_run.json; refuses a run whose split is not development (B11)
Spot x vol stress grid Full revaluation
manifest.json + dataset JSON files Written today: manifest, illustrative_surface (M0), data_quality (M1), surface_frames (M2), blotter and positions_timeline (M3). The M4 to M6 datasets are planned
Blotter tab Fills and expiry events of the engine run; a diagnostic, not a result
Positions tab Positions from open to close and the count open each session
React app renders the other tabs About, Surface, Data quality and Architecture; reads only app/public/data/*.json
SELECT on the mirror, exported to data/raw/
flag counts, calendar, rows per date

the slice dated t, within the view's bound
require_current: tables made by the current code over the current inputs
